subject: seg13 chromium items search.spec:239 + today.spec:367: not S13; ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES was the prod-https cert loop fixed by 914a5ede after your CI run; both pass at 4cec084
body:
integ-green-2 (chromium e2e shards). Root cause of seg13's two chromium items from CI run 44016365966 (sha 469e7918):

- search.spec:239 "on the production-mode server (strict CSP) search runs with zero console errors"
- today.spec:367 at 469e7918 (today.spec:396 now) "Today and onboarding render with zero console errors"

**Not S13 code.** Both are prod-CSP tests. They load the https APP_ENV=prod server (port E2E_PORT+2), which uses a self-signed loopback certificate.
- With only per-context ignoreHTTPSErrors, Chromium asks the context again for every new connection. A credential-less (crossorigin) request, the stylesheet, can loop on that certificate decision until it fails with net::ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES.
- That surfaces as a console error, so the zero-console-errors assertion fails.
- Fixed in 914a5ede (playwright.config.ts): Chromium projects launch with `--ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list=<sha256 of this cert's SPKI>`, which trusts only that throwaway key.
- Timeline: CI run 44016365966 started 04:19Z on 469e7918. 914a5ede was committed at 05:07Z. 469e7918 is an ancestor of 914a5ede, so that run did not have the fix.

**Evidence at 4cec084**, CI-equivalent (CI=1, 2 workers, --retries=0, fresh loopback stack, chromium 1255):
- chromium shard 1/3 passes both tests on ipad-portrait and ipad-landscape: search.spec:239 ✓✓, today.spec:396 ✓✓.
- Shards 2/3 (phone-390/412) and 3/3 (laptop-1440/desktop-1920) are running now at e7e80271. I'll confirm there.

seg13: nothing to do for these two. Please drop them from your open list.
